description.value: Great Northern SnowCat Skiing is a boutique backcountry ski lodge operating since 1979 in the Bad Shot Range of the Selkirk Mountains, offering guided snowcat powder skiing across 75 sq km of terrain with over 15 m of annual snowfall. Guests drive directly to the remote lodge, which emphasizes a family-like atmosphere, small groups, and on-site meals. It is a seasonal winter operation; cyclists visiting outside ski season should confirm availability in advance.
